title: Shared presentation of full scalar restriction squares
statement: For a condensed commutative coefficient ring Lambda and f:X -> S, ScalarRightDerived Lambda f abbreviates the full universal direct-image model DiagonalRightDerived(lowerStar Lambda f) of [lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived]. For a coefficient map a:Lambda -> Lambda-prime, CanonicalScalarSquare a f R abbreviates exactly the RestrictionSquare of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars] from R to the canonical Lambda-prime model. ScalarMateIsIso a s abbreviates exactly the proposition that for every K in the unbounded derived category of Lambda modules on X, the actual scalar mate of s at K is an isomorphism. These aliases add no data, hypothesis, quotient, or normalization.

source.place: Paragraph (1): full universal integral direct-image model, normalized restriction square to the canonical quotient model, and its actual scalar mate on every unbounded complex.
